Document #004: Technical Analysis of Healthcare Informatics

1. Primary Architecture Overview
Electronic health record standards ensure patient data privacy.
Federated learning enables cross-hospital diagnostic models.
Key benchmark targets high throughput under load.
System latency remains sub-50ms at peak traffic.

2. Implementation & Empirical Results
Clinical NLP extracts structured terms from physician notes.
Audit trails ensure strict compliance with HIPAA mandates.
Decoupled components scale horizontally on demand.
Empirical verification confirms zero data loss.
